section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction outlines a study examining associations between Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS) factors and body appreciation in women, predicting negative associations for the Stereotypic Image and Purity factors. The section reports a sample size (N = 135) but provides no further methodological or demographic details (e.g., country, age, BMI, race, assessment instruments) and does not label multiple studies.
